title: A proteome-scale reverse screening approach reveals multi-target interactions of anthraquinone derivatives in cancer-related pathways.
authors: Ramezani Pastaky, Faezeh; Hassani Kumleh, Hassan; Arab, Seyed Shahriar; Rezadoost, Mohammad Hossein; Taghvaei, Mohammad Mahdi
one_liner_zh: 对五种蒽醌衍生物进行蛋白质组规模反向虚拟筛选与分子动力学验证，属小分子多靶点对接研究，蛋白质结构为筛选对象但非核心建模目标，方法可迁移至蛋白-配体对接场景。
abstract: Cancer is a multifactorial and heterogeneous disease in which single-target therapeutic strategies often fail to achieve sustained efficacy. Anthraquinone derivatives exhibit diverse anticancer activities; however, their comprehensive molecular targets and mechanisms of action remain incompletely characterized. In this study, a proteome-wide reverse virtual screening strategy was applied to identify potential human protein targets of five sugar-free anthraquinone derivatives, including emodin, chrysophanol, aloe-emodin, physcion, and rhein. 67,000 human protein structures were screened using AutoDock Vina, followed by binding energy-based filtering and removal of redundant targets, resulting in 123 non-redundant proteins. Functional annotation and pathway analysis revealed cancer-associated biological processes linked to the identified targets. Comparative pathway analysis identified 64 overlapping pathways, from which 10 key pathways and six core protein targets were prioritized based on multi-ligand convergence. Predicted binding affinities of the retained ligand-target combinations for the prioritized targets ranged from -9.0 to -10.7 kcal/mol, with emodin and chrysophanol showing comparatively stronger binding affinities. LigPlot + analysis characterized hydrogen-bonding and hydrophobic interactions involved in ligand stabilization. Furthermore, 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations showed that 19 of the 27 simulated ligand-protein complexes retained the predicted binding mode, while the remainder underwent partial or complete ligand dissociation, and in silico ADMET analysis indicated acceptable drug-like properties and pharmacokinetic profiles. Overall, this integrative computational framework combines proteome-scale target discovery, pathway prioritization, structural validation, molecular dynamics, and ADMET evaluation to provide a systems-level perspective on the potential multi-target anticancer mechanisms of anthraquinone derivatives and identify candidate targets for future experimental validation.
abstract_zh: 癌症是一种多因素、异质性疾病，单靶点治疗策略往往难以实现持续疗效。蒽醌衍生物表现出多样的抗癌活性；然而，其全面的分子靶点和作用机制仍未得到充分表征。本研究采用全蛋白质组反向虚拟筛选策略，鉴定五种无糖蒽醌衍生物的潜在人类蛋白靶点，包括大黄素 (emodin)、大黄酚 (chrysophanol)、芦荟大黄素 (aloe-emodin)、大黄素甲醚 (physcion) 和大黄酸 (rhein)。使用 AutoDock Vina 对 67,000 个人类蛋白质结构进行筛选，随后基于结合能进行过滤并去除冗余靶点，最终获得 123 个非冗余蛋白质。功能注释和通路分析揭示了与所鉴定靶点相关的癌症相关生物学过程。比较通路分析鉴定出 64 条重叠通路，并基于多配体汇聚从中优先选出 10 条关键通路和六个核心蛋白靶点。保留的配体-靶点组合对优先靶点的预测结合亲和力范围为 -9.0 至 -10.7 kcal/mol，其中大黄素和大黄酚表现出相对更强的结合亲和力。LigPlot + 分析表征了参与配体稳定化的氢键和疏水相互作用。此外，100 ns 分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟显示，27 个模拟的配体-蛋白复合物中有 19 个保留了预测的结合模式，其余则发生部分或完全配体解离，计算机 ADMET 分析表明其具有可接受的类药性质和药代动力学特征。总体而言，这一整合计算框架结合了蛋白质组规模靶点发现、通路优先级排序、结构验证、分子动力学和 ADMET 评估，为蒽醌衍生物的潜在多靶点抗癌机制提供了系统层面的视角，并鉴定了可用于未来实验验证的候选靶点。
